name: [Hardcore] TrenchLine:Tower Defense
desc:
v0.25.0 (11/7/26): FLOOD STAGE 2
NEW HARDCORE MODE: Tidefall Beach. 40 waves, landing craft and a new sea horde
Final boss: the Barnacle Behemoth on wave 40
Naval Tokens now only drop in Hardcore. Spend them on the Tokens page
Anti-air troops: Shilka and MANPADS Team
5 new emotes
Fixes: range circles, boat shells, UI scaling on big screens

The tide is coming in. Hold the line.

Trench Line is a co-op zombie tower defense game. Build your defenses, upgrade your troops and stop the infected before they break through.

BUILD YOUR LINE
Riflemen, machine gunners, snipers, mortars, tanks, gunships, boats and anti-air.

SURVIVE THE HORDE
Shamblers, runners, armored infected, Brutes, flyers and the Drowned from the sea.

✅ Easy ✅ Medium ✅ Hard ☠️ENDLESS☠️ 🌊HARDCORE🌊
Squad up with friends and hold the trench together.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!

llm.loop: pick map -> deploy troops (riflemen, mortars, tanks, boats) -> stop zombie waves -> earn coins/tokens -> unlock units
llm.objectives: hold the line against infected waves
llm.instructions: build defenses, upgrade troops, stop infected; co-op
unique: military trench zombie TD with naval flood maps
update_signals: THE FLOOD UPDATE v0.24, frequent versioned patches
